notes.title: Journal update
notes.content:
Journal Update: You can now review all your past choices by clicking the header at the top of the screen — perfect for catching up on story you might’ve skipped by an accidental click.

Character Creation: Couple of minor improvements for a smoother experience.

Prologue: Slight polish and a hidden achievement added.

Bug Fix: Clicks are no longer registered when the game is inactive — such as during alt+tab or in windowed mode.

notes.title: Settings update, various bug fixes
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

Sound Settings: You can now adjust the master volume, music, button sounds, and other sound effects independently.

Graphics Settings: You can now disable background images entirely — for players who prefer a simpler interface or just like things a bit more... minimalist.

Bug Fix: Shops in Skjalaborg are working again. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Battle special conditions update
notes.content:
I've just released another small update for the demo! Until now, most battles felt quite similar, and many of you likely stuck with just one weapon. That’s about to change — from now on, many encounters come with special conditions that grant bonuses or penalties to certain skills.

For example, fighting in a shield wall formation gives you a bonus to shield and spear skills. So be sure to adapt — swap your weapon to match the situation and make the most of every battle!
